Shanghai Municipal Council.

（印：SHANGHAI MUNICIPAL COUNCIL POLICE FORCE）
POLICE FORCE,
(DETECTIVE BRANCH)

November 17th 1916

Sir,
    The committee of the painters guild held a
meeting in their house on Park Road at 3 p.m. 16th
inst for the purpose of selecting party organisers
who will receive salaries of $12.00 each per month.
Nine men were selected for the work. They will be
employed in different parts of Shanghai including
the Settlement, Frenchtown, Chapei and City
for the purpose of carrying on propaganda among
painters of the different cities such as Ningpo,
Soochow, Shaoshing etc. The meeting terminated at
4 p.m.
    Loo Vung San (罗国山) the ex-rebel called on
the British Consul at 10.30 a.m. 18th inst and asked
for assistance. The Consul promised that he would
consider the matter.
    It is reported that the Arsenal Authorities
will test big guns to-day and to-morrow.
    The coffin containing the remains of General
Tsai Ao is expected here soon. It will be brought
from Japan by a Chinese cruiser. When the coffin
arrives a memorial service in honour of the deceased
will be held in the Szechow Guild in Chapei. This
function is being promoted by the milk merchants
of Shanghai.
    The different republican societies in Shanghai
are planning to give a farewell entertainment to Dr.
Wu Ting Fang in Chang Su Ho's garden before he leaves
for Peking.

                Your Obedient Servant,

                M B Newman

                Detective Sub Inspector.

Captain Superintendent of Police.

上海工部局。

（印章：上海工部局警务处）
警务处，
（侦探科）

1916年11月17日

先生：
油漆业公会委员会于本月16日下午3时在该会位于公园路（Park Road）的会所举行会议，旨在遴选党务组织者，每人月薪12.00美元。共选出九人承担此项工作。他们将在上海不同地区受雇，包括租界、法租界、闸北及华界，目的是在来自宁波、苏州、绍兴等不同城市的油漆匠中开展宣传工作。会议于下午4时结束。
前叛乱分子罗国山（Loo Vung San）于本月18日上午10时30分拜会英国领事，请求援助。领事答应将考虑此事。
据报，兵工厂当局将于今日和明日试射大炮。
载有蔡锷将军遗体的灵柩预计不久将抵达此处。该灵柩将由一艘中国巡洋舰从日本运回。灵柩抵达后，将在闸北的四川公所举行追悼会，以纪念逝者。此活动由上海的奶商发起。
上海各共和社团正计划在吴廷芳博士（Dr. Wu Ting Fang）赴京之前，于张叔和（Chang Su Ho）的花园为其举行欢送宴会。

                您顺从的仆人，

                M B Newman

                侦探副督察。

警务总监上尉。

November 17th        191⁶.

REPORT ON A meeting at 697 Park Road.

Made by    D.I. Fitzgibbon.    Forwarded by Inspector Sims.

Sir,
Between 3.30 & 4.30 P.M. on
16th inst. Zung Ing Ny1(陳引年 ) presided at a meeting
held at Painter's Guild 697 Park Road where 20 headmen
assembled, the eight new clauses in the rules governing the
Establishment having been passed unanimously. It was also
decided to raise funds towards the upkeep of a Hospital for
their sick.

Yours Obediently
Maurice Fitzgibbon
Det. Insp.

Chief Detective Inspector.

191⁶年11月17日。

关于公园路697号会议的报告。

由侦探督察菲茨吉本（D.I. Fitzgibbon）撰写。由西姆斯督察（Inspector Sims）转呈。

先生：
本月16日下午3时30分至4时30分之间，陈引年（Zung Ing Ny1）主持了在公园路697号油漆业公会举行的会议，20名头面人物出席，一致通过了关于该机构规章制度的八项新条款。会议还决定筹集资金，用于维持其病患医院的经营。
